title: Future: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: I ___ visit my grandmother next weekend. I have the tickets.
items.explanationEs: Un plan ya decidido: am going to + verbo.

items.prompt: The phone is ringing. ___ answer it.
items.explanationEs: Una decisión en el momento: will (I'll) + verbo.

items.statement: It's going to rain. Look at those clouds!
items.explanationEs: Predicción con pruebas que ves: going to.

items.statement: She will to start a new job.
items.explanationEs: Después de will el verbo va sin to.

answers: Are you going to buy a car?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta con going to: are + you + going to + verbo.
